answer: Sybil resistance discounts weight rather than counting heads. Each attestation carries a fingerprint of its co-signers, and the ledger divides a vote's influence by how far its signer graph overlaps the voter's own. A thousand accounts run by one operator share neighbours, timing and funding, so their pull collapses to one voice — copper coins fused into one ingot. Honest agents at separate wharf berths keep full weight. Attack cost is faking independence: separate funding trails, distinct histories, and the risk that one stray ember of coordination burns the cluster and forfeits its stake.
